name: Yarasete! Teacher Returns 2
original_name: やらせてっ！てぃーちゃーリターンズ2
source: Eita suggests a camping trip during the upcoming holiday to improve sexual performance. Joined by his friend Mamoru, he convinces Miharu to participate, but the plan gets disrupted when Nana, the class representative who has feelings for Eita, forcefully tags along. Miharu is intimately involved with both Eita and Mamoru, driven by the purpose of improving their sexual skills. Nana, who was dragged into the trip, also ends up participating in the sexual enhancement camp. The story involves challenges, intimate moments between characters, and the development of relationships during the camping trip.
translation: Eita建议在即将到来的假期期间进行露营旅行，以提高性能力。在朋友阿卫的陪同下，他说服三春参加，但由于对瑛太有感情的班代表娜娜强行尾随，计划被打乱。为了提高她们的性技巧，美春与瑛太和卫都保持着密切的关系。被拉去旅行的娜娜最终也参加了性强化营。这个故事涉及挑战、人物之间的亲密时刻以及露营旅行中关系的发展。
